title: Market Clearing Percentile (conditional distribution of accepted-trade residuals)
current_system: Fairness bands v2 classify the gap on our board; nothing describes where real trades clear
current_method: Point gap vs fixed 3.5/9/18% cut points
evidence: 6/29 completed own-league multi-piece trades classify 'fair' under the live owner (research.json multiPieceTrades); market equal-count held-out meanAbs residual 0.166 (production_phase3_run_2026-10-20.json); docs/research/amath/SITEWIDE_TRADES_2026-11-01.md section 8.1
proposed: Pooled conditional quantiles / rolling split-conformal intervals of r given shape, noise-balanced level and pick share; private percentile label beside (never replacing) the band
mechanism: Places a proposed trade within the distribution of trades that actually cleared, league-disjoint and time-forward
data_available: 18,690 PIT-graded market trades (box data/intel); 233 own-league trades
consumers: /trade meter (private), Analyze market lens, Best Offers, OD-F4
risk: Misread as fairness; exchangeability violated by drift and lineage clustering; public exposure is a boundary change (BLOCKED-owner)
acceptance: Prospective 80% coverage in [0.75,0.85] pooled and every shape in [0.70,0.90]; interval score beats unconditional with league-cluster CI excluding 0
rejection: Coverage outside bands, or no interval-score gain
novelty_note: Uncertain novelty: the KTC trade database lists trades but, to our knowledge, does not publish a conditional clearing percentile for an arbitrary package

title: Executable OD-F4 validation protocol for fairness_bands_v2
current_method: Owner-approved PRIOR thresholds inherited from the KTC-era meter
proposed: Preregistered band hit-rate report on PIT market trades by shape x level, league-disjoint and time-forward; evidence only; any change is a new owner-approved version
mechanism: Measures what share of cleared trades each band captures, and whether band level predicts later How It Aged drift
risk: Mistaken as authority to change bands (BLOCKED-owner)
evaluation: Shares per band with league-cluster CIs; stability across sources and periods
acceptance: Report reproduced on two freezes with identical method
rejection: Ledger insufficient (<2,000 prospective unequal trades) -> defer

title: Simplify or remove the live Monte Carlo 'win rate' built on synthetic flat +/-15% bands
current_method: Triangular draws from synthesized p10/p50/p90 = v*0.85 / v / v*1.15 plus two ad-hoc correlation factors
evidence: No valueBand producer in src/api/data_contract.py; MonteCarloButton.jsx:65-68 synthesizes the band; the module docstring records 0/1093 rows stamped; open-modeling-decisions #4
baseline: Show the gap and band only (already shown)
proposed: Hide the win rate until real per-asset uncertainty exists; later replace with posterior P(gap>0) from a source-vote bootstrap (after AM-TRADES-08)
mechanism: The output is a deterministic monotone transform of the gap presented in probability units
risk: UI change is owner-visible; some users may miss the number
evaluation: Static check that winProb is a function of gap and values under synthetic bands; button-usage telemetry if any
rejection: A real valueBand producer ships with calibration evidence (then re-evaluate as R)

title: Dynasty Regret Simulator (expected utility, regret and CVaR vs NO ACTION)
current_system: Rule table over market band (A) and BBLI (B); shadow v3 with D1/D2 outcome terms
current_method: Goal-keyed classification of point components; no utility, no regret
evidence: Decision configs labelled PRIOR with no outcome data (config/trade/analyze_trade.json, decision_engine_v1.json); ROS G3 FAILED and Sim V3 failed gates (#2053)
baseline: Scenario MC over {GEOM, KTC, VG} package views with conservative tie (v3 TIE=NO)
proposed: U = sum_t delta^t P(title_t) w + lambda * terminal market value; paired CRN scenarios of value trajectories (archive log-return bootstrap by position x age tier, BDVM hazard tail) and title equity; reports E[dU], P(regret>x), CVaR_10; private shadow
mechanism: Makes regret and downside explicit and compares every trade with holding
data_available: BBLI paired draws, playoff_sim, BDVM survival, 110 days of archive values
data_missing: Multi-season value-return history; calibrated title odds; outcome labels
risk: Uncalibrated inputs yield confident-looking regret; replacing B3 is BLOCKED-owner
evaluation: Proper scoring of components (title-prob Brier, value-return interval coverage) plus a disagreement audit vs B3
acceptance: Components calibrated within preregistered tolerance on forward weeks; explanations reviewed
rejection: Component coverage failure, or no disagreement with B3 that survives review
effort: 8-15 engineer-days after AM-TRADES-08 and ROS calibration
related_roadmap: AMATH #8 and principle 4 (#2053); C7-DESK-01; FFBB-4; MD-4; MD-11
novelty_note: Uncertain novelty: commercial analyzers show win-now vs future splits; paired-CRN regret/CVaR vs no-action is believed uncommon

title: No-Action Advantage score
current_system: Conservative tie in v3; NO_TOO_CLOSE in the served decision
current_method: Binary 'too close' from a fixed band
evidence: BBLI already publishes paired MC SE (best_ball_utility.py); no continuous hold-vs-trade measure exists
proposed: NAA = P(U_hold >= U_trade) and E[(U_trade - U_hold)+] from paired BBLI draws plus a gap posterior; shown beside Best Offers and Finder so 'no trade' is a scored option
risk: Overlaps v3 tie semantics; must not become a second decision owner
evaluation: Shadow log of NAA vs the served decision; rank correlation with later How It Aged drift
acceptance: NAA monotone with drift (Spearman CI > 0) on forward data
rejection: No relation with any forward outcome

title: Trade-window timing: Title-Equity Exchange Rate
current_system: Competitive Posture labels (PUSH/HOLD/RETOOL/REBUILD) from prior anchors
current_method: Soft assignment to prior anchors plus deadline sharpening
evidence: window.py constants all PRIOR; never validated against team behaviour
proposed: Per team and season, d P(title_s) / d(market value into starters) by paired perturbation in playoff_sim, combined with asset value drift; a buy/sell window signal; a separately named concept that consumes posture
mechanism: Quantifies the marginal title equity of market value now vs later
data_missing: Calibrated title odds (labelled uncalibrated per MD-11)
risk: Double counting posture lineage; uncalibrated odds
evaluation: Shadow; check sign agreement with posture and with subsequent behaviour
acceptance: Stable estimates (small seed variance) that are interpretable on real teams
rejection: Unstable across seeds, or contradicts posture without explanation
novelty_note: Original framing (exchange rate of title equity per market point); uncertain novelty

title: Partial identification of package q (and level c) by moment inequalities
current_method: Minimize mean residual-to-even over model families
evidence: residualByQExtended monotone down to q=0.2 (research.json); VG_q_c best fit q 0.85, c 2,000 (Phase 3 section 6.1); lineage clusters about 2-4 (LINEAGE_COMPONENT_CENSUS_2026-10-21.md)
baseline: Existing point fits and the decoy test
proposed: Revealed-preference inequalities u_i(R_i) - u_i(G_i) >= kappa_i give an identified set for (q, c) (Pakes-Porter-Ho-Ishii 2015; Chernozhukov-Hong-Tamer 2007); report the set, not a point; decoy conditional-logit ranking across models
mechanism: Replaces an equality assumption that is false under acceptance with inequalities
data_missing: Choice sets (alternative partners), kappa, rejected offers
risk: Over-interpretation; any formula change is BLOCKED-owner (frozen R1 KEEP)
evaluation: Set estimate with cluster-robust inference on discovery, checked on confirmation
acceptance: The identified set is reported honestly with its width (whether or not it contains 0.78)
rejection: Set uninformative (all of [0,1]) -> record as NOT_IDENTIFIABLE (IC-3 state)
novelty_note: Methodologically uncommon in fantasy; standard in IO econometrics

title: Errors-in-variables decomposition of accepted-trade residual dispersion
current_system: Residual reports (mean signed, meanAbs) by shape and level
evidence: Equal-count held-out meanAbs 0.166; own-league 1-for-1 noise floor 0.206 (research.json)
proposed: log|r| = b_shape + gamma log sigma + delta level; sigma = value-weighted source CV, single-source share, low-confidence share, freshness-excluded share; gamma = noise elasticity
mechanism: Separates board noise from genuine market disagreement and heterogeneous preferences
data_available: Ledger plus contract diagnostic fields (sourceSpread, confidence axes)
data_missing: Per-asset PIT confidence fields for older boards may be absent
risk: Correlated families make CV a biased proxy
acceptance: gamma > 0 with clustered CI excluding 0 in both source families

title: Validate or relabel the Finder/Angle 'arbitrage' edge (convergence test)
current_system: Board vs retail market gap treated as our edge
current_method: Rank candidates by board - market gap with ported thresholds (MIN_ASSET_VALUE 700, ELITE 6600, _BOARD_EDGE_WEIGHT 50)
evidence: No predictive validation in repo. Exploratory diagnostic: 21-day KTC momentum slope +0.085 [0.009, 0.161] (4 origins); slope of future KTC change on log(IDPTC/KTC) -0.197 [-0.286, -0.119] with IDPTC stale (5/109 changes); docs/research/amath/SITEWIDE_TRADES_2026-11-01.md section 8.2
proposed: PIT regression Delta log M_{t->t+h} = alpha_t + beta g_t + theta x_t, with g' computed from a board rebuilt without the KTC vote; two-way clustered / wild-cluster bootstrap
mechanism: Tests whether the market moves toward our board
data_available: 153 tracked export archives (110 days), pinned pipeline
risk: Few time origins; KTC is a board voter (mechanical correlation)
acceptance: beta > 0 with CI excluding 0, same sign at h=28, top decile beats bottom prospectively
rejection: beta CI includes 0 or is negative -> recommend relabel (owner copy decision)
novelty_note: Uncertain novelty; consensus-convergence ideas circulate informally in community analysis

title: Empirical-Bayes partial pooling for manager tendencies and archetypes
current_system: Raw shares once n>=3; archetype hard cut-offs
current_method: Counts/shares with insufficient_sample gate; threshold archetypes
evidence: Constants labelled 'PRIOR (declared, not fitted or validated)' in manager_career.py:93; TENDENCY_MIN_SAMPLE = 3
proposed: Beta-binomial / Dirichlet-multinomial / gamma-Poisson EB toward a declared population (league roster preferred); posterior mean plus 80% interval; archetype = P(rate > threshold) >= 0.8
mechanism: Shrinks noisy small-sample shares toward the population while keeping explicit insufficiency
data_available: Manager activity and career payloads; league scouting rows
risk: Prior choice drives results; must stay private
evaluation: Leave-one-season-out predictive log score of next-season shares vs raw and vs counts
acceptance: EB log score beats raw shares with cluster CI excluding 0
novelty_note: Standard method (Efron-Morris); novel in this product

title: Sharp Score: shrunk all-play win% and selection sensitivity
current_system: Weighted percentile score with raw win% plus championship beta-binomial
evidence: scoring_v2.json: weights 'not validated against an outcome dataset'
proposed: All-play win% with EB shrinkage by games; league-strength random effect; sensitivity of the cohort to snowball discovery order
data_missing: All-play weekly data per league may be uncollected
risk: Changing the cohort moves Sharp surfaces
evaluation: Year-ahead persistence of score (rank correlation), raw vs shrunk

title: Causal effect of manager skill or advisor use (SCM/DML/TMLE)
current_method: Descriptive tendencies and At-the-Time / How It Aged grades
evidence: No exogenous variation, interference within leagues, single-digit n per manager, outcomes dominated by luck and injury
baseline: Descriptive realized value added vs hold at PIT values (KEEP)
mechanism: Identification fails: confounding by team strength and window, no overlap, interference
rejection: Rejected now; revisit only with an identifying design

title: Private Offer Ledger (decision-data capture for acceptance and regret)
current_system: Accepted trades only; served-decision log not joined to user actions
current_method: Acceptance unidentifiable; manager term gated at 30 decisions and z>=2
evidence: partner.py MANAGER_EVIDENCE_MIN_DECISIONS docstring; trade_decision_log has no outcome join
proposed: Opt-in private logging of offers the user sent or received with outcome (accepted/rejected/countered/expired), joined to the PIT board and decision receipts
principle: 9 selection (fixes missingness by design); 10 regret evaluation
mechanism: Creates the reject data that makes acceptance and decision regret estimable
data_missing: All of the outcome data (to be collected)
risk: Privacy (the user's own actions only); low adoption keeps n small
evaluation: Count accumulated decisions per manager and per user
acceptance: Data accrues with consent and an audit trail; no third-party profiling beyond existing private scope
rejection: Adoption too low to reach any gate within a season

title: Re-express legacy Suggestions/Finder gates in band/percent units
current_method: Absolute-point gates from the KTC-era / composite scale
evidence: suggestions.py comment: 769's origin is undocumented legacy tuning (PRIOR, calibrated under KTC)
proposed: Express gates as fractions of the larger package utility; measure before/after suggestion volume as the code requires
mechanism: Consistent units with the one band owner
risk: Volume shifts; generator gates are not verdicts
acceptance: Volume within declared tolerance and no new illegal suggestions

title: Shadow behavioural check of Competitive Posture
evidence: All constants PRIOR; owner chose the map 2026-10-03
proposed: Measure agreement between posture and next-4-week net buy/sell direction (ordinal agreement, Brier on directional share), own league plus Sharp leagues
mechanism: Tests whether the labels describe behaviour
data_missing: Historical posture snapshots (no as-of store; must be recorded forward)
acceptance: Agreement above a preregistered baseline (e.g. a lineup-rank-only rule)

title: Pick-market c: add log score / reliability and cross-season pooling once calibrated
current_system: Brier-fitted shrinkage c per progress bucket after 24 outcomes
proposed: Beta prior on c pooled across seasons; reliability diagrams; log score as secondary
acceptance: Pooled c no worse on a held-out season
